subject: Next steps and vendor portal items — CloudReach / Redwood follow-up
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Barnes <alex.barnes@cloudreach.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps and vendor portal items — CloudReach / Redwood follow-up

Alex — great to connect earlier. Quick recap and the asks we discussed so procurement can move forward:

- Summary: we covered latency/cost targets for your inference workload, estimated commit tiers, and options for a Dedicated pool vs hosted with burst. You confirmed data residency needs (US-East) and SSO requirement for admin console.

- Mutual action plan (next items):
  1) Redwood to send vendor packet, ACH form, and W-9 for signature (attached).
  2) CloudReach to confirm procurement contact and target go-live month.
  3) Once vendor profile is created we’ll issue the portal invite for service onboarding and SSO setup.

Open questions I noted: payment terms (Net30 vs Net45), whether CloudReach prefers invoice or ACH, and desired capacity for initial prod traffic.

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Packet.pdf, Redwood_ACH_Form.xlsx, W9_DocuSign_Link.url (stubs attached).

If you can loop in the procurement contact (or confirm Dana Ortiz is the right person), we’ll have Marissa (ops) prepare the portal invite immediately after the packet is accepted. Suggested next step: Dana + procurement confirm by EOB next Tue so we can target a June 28 onboarding.

Thanks — I’ll be on standby to jump on a short call if useful.

— Soojin

From: Alex Barnes <alex.barnes@cloudreach.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 09:18:14 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps and vendor portal items — CloudReach / Redwood follow-up

Thanks Soojin — appreciate the clear recap. A couple quick items from our side:

- Procurement: Dana Ortiz (Finance Ops) owns vendor setup, I’ve cc’d her in a follow-up (she’s not on this thread yet). Dana handles W-9s/ACH.
- Payment terms: we typically start Net30, but I’ll confirm with Dana if Net45 is required for third-party services.
- Timeline: we’d like to get the portal invite faster if possible; if Redwood can get Marissa to send the invite once vendor packet is accepted, that would help us start SSO integration early.

Two small clarification questions:
1) Will the portal invite include a link to the admin console and SSO metadata?
2) Is the W-9 being sent via DocuSign or via PDF upload?

If you can send the DocuSign link for the W-9, that would speed us up. Happy to hop on a 15-min call if it helps align.

— Alex
Alex Barnes
Head of Cloud Partnerships | CloudReach
alex.barnes@cloudreach.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Barnes <alex.barnes@cloudreach.com>, Dana Ortiz <dana.ortiz@cloudreach.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps and vendor portal items — CloudReach / Redwood follow-up

Alex — perfect, thanks for confirming Dana. Dana — great to meet you (looping Marissa from ops so she can prepare the portal).

To answer your questions: the portal invite includes admin console access and an SSO metadata upload flow (we’ll send the SAML metadata and a short SSO checklist). The W-9 is set up as a DocuSign flow — link is attached (W9_DocuSign_Link.url).

I’ve attached the vendor packet and ACH template again for convenience. Marissa — once Dana confirms the vendor name exactly as it should appear on the portal (company legal name + remit details) can you:
  - create the CloudReach vendor profile in our portal,
  - trigger the invite to the CloudReach admin email, and
  - set the onboarding kickoff slot for the week of 6/28 pending confirmation.

Dana — can you confirm: preferred remit method (ACH or invoice), and whether Net30 is acceptable? If you’d rather I route a formal PO to billing, we can accept that too.

DocuSign / attachments: W9 link (DocuSign), Redwood_ACH_Form.xlsx, Redwood_Vendor_Packet.pdf.

Thanks — happy to jump on a short call with Dana + Marissa to clear anything.

— Soojin

Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Checking in on vendor packet & portal invite (gentle nudge)

Hi Alex / Dana — circling back on this thread. We haven’t seen the signed W-9 or ACH confirmation come through and wanted to check if anything changed on your side or if the timeline shifted.

If priorities moved, no problem — just let us know the target month and we’ll adjust our onboarding calendar. If you’re still aiming for late June, can Dana confirm the vendor name and preferred remit method today or tomorrow so Marissa can trigger the portal invite?

If it helps, I can:
- schedule a 15-min sync with Dana + Marissa to get the outstanding items completed, or
- have Ben (Billing) send a payment-terms summary and a one-page vendor checklist to speed signoff.

Thanks — short replies are totally fine here if that’s easiest.

— Soojin
